column2: a modern fixed-blade field knife game prop with its sheath shown below it, generic original design: clip-point blade with a straight edge and a flat grind line, small finger guard, textured polymer handle with a lanyard hole pommel, blade satin steel #9A9CA0, handle dark olive #6B7A3A, sheath near-black #1C1D1F with a belt clip

a katana game prop with its scabbard shown below it, generic original design: gently curved single-edge blade with a visible temper line, round steel guard, wrapped handle with diamond wrap pattern over cream ray skin, small end cap, blade steel #B8BABD, handle wrap near-black #1C1D1F, scabbard dark olive #6B7A3A with a cord near the mouth

a wooden baseball bat game prop, generic original design: round knob, thin handle with black grip tape wrapped in a spiral, smooth taper to a thick rounded barrel end, light wood #C8A878 with a darker burned band near the barrel, no text, no logo

a rectangular tactical riot shield game prop , seen from the front: tall rectangle with rounded top corners, slightly curved, a horizontal view window near the top, a raised rim, small flashlight mounted at the top right, matte near-black #1C1D1F body with a warm grey #C8C4BA rim, no text, no logo

a pair of tactical fingerless hand wraps / padded knuckle wraps game prop, flat lay seen from above, generic original design: wrapped cloth bands in dark olive #6B7A3A with a near-black #1C1D1F padded knuckle strip and a velcro wrist strap, no hands inside

a cylindrical smoke grenade game prop, generic original design: steel can with four emission holes on top and bottom, safety spoon lever along the side, pull ring with a cotter pin at the top, olive drab can #6B7A3A with a cream #ECE8DA band and no text

a flashbang stun grenade game prop, generic original design: steel cylinder with rows of rectangular vent ports along the body, safety spoon lever along the side, pull ring and pin at the top, light grey steel #C8C4BA with a dark band, no text

a fragmentation hand grenade game prop, generic original design: smooth egg-shaped steel body, fuze assembly on top with a safety spoon lever down the side and a pull ring with pin, dark olive body #6B7A3A, fuze metal grey #6E7076, a cream #ECE8DA band, no text

a sticky grenade game prop, generic original design: round ball grenade wrapped in a dark adhesive cover with a peel-off backing tab, small fuze on top with a spoon lever and pull ring, near-black #1C1D1F body with a sage #A7AD98 adhesive band, no text

a compact anti-personnel land mine game prop, generic original design: low round disc body with a raised pressure plate on top, a small arming switch and a safety pin with a ring on the side, olive drab #6B7A3A body, darker top plate, no text

a compact first aid kit game prop, generic original design: hard-shell olive drab #6B7A3A case with a cream #ECE8DA cross on the lid, two side latches, a carry handle on top, the lid slightly open showing an auto-injector and a bandage roll inside, no text, no red
